name: Leather Technique
summary: Talra in Gelkis Village seeks a Barbaric Harness to study its leather technique. The Gelkis have resisted wearing armor, and leather is too scarce to waste.

sections.title: Talra’s Request
sections.body: Talra of the Gelkis asks you to bring her a Barbaric Harness in Gelkis Village, in Desolace. Her clanmates resist wearing armor despite their losses to blades and bolts. Talra hopes to design a protective vest without the discomfort they complain of, and wants to study the harness before using scarce leather.

faq.q: Who is asking for the harness?
faq.answer: Talra, a member of the Gelkis clan, asks you to bring her a Barbaric Harness in Gelkis Village.

faq.q: Why does Talra want a Barbaric Harness?
aliases: what does Talra need it for
faq.answer: Talra wants to study its technique while designing a protective vest for her clanmates.

faq.q: Why is Talra designing a vest?
faq.answer: Her Gelkis clanmates resist wearing armor despite suffering losses to blades and bolts.

faq.q: What bothers the Gelkis about armor?
faq.answer: They complain that armor is itchy.
Talra is in Gelkis Village in Desolace.

faq.q: Why must the leather be used carefully?
faq.answer: Supplies are scarce, so Talra does not want to waste leather on a poor design.
